notes: This graph is a machine-readable routing index, not theory authority.
Do not invent missing branches from filenames, worker names, or recurrence labels.
A worker change, method change, repository move, or bounded step does not by itself create a new branch.

Nathan Direct 2026-09-20 reweights the active edge from excavation/preservation as the dominant mode toward bold sandboxed construction and projection/benchmark work. Confidence attaches first to faithful representation/reproduction of accepted physics; it does not automatically transfer to SAT/H(s)H derivation, novelty, or validation.

branches.title: Geometric solver vs standard-equation side-by-side pipeline
branches.intent: Build an auditable Python-capable comparison harness for matched SAT/H(s)H geometric-solver and standard/reference-equation cases without hiding target leakage, fit freedom, units, transformations, or representation assumptions.
exposure_constraints: Do not treat numerical agreement as derivation or validation
dependencies: Recover or preserve candidate status of the exact Hagalaz operator
Use one declared shared material/director gauge before comparing translation residuals
branches.last_material_state: ACTIVE-EDGE ADVANCE: Meridian Run 078 (commit 1b793334473d72c5887f9c891488931c91f1ed21) formalized the Sim(4) translation-gauge gate exposed by Run 077. Under similarity-frame conjugation, scale is unchanged and rotation class functions remain safe, but translation acquires both origin-dependent and unit-scale terms. Raw translation norms therefore cannot be compared across independently gauged Hagalaz/UI and Three-Spheres representations. A shared primitive material/director gauge is now the preferred first benchmark; otherwise translation must be excluded in favor of conjugacy-safe quantities. Exact September-11 Hagalaz source remains unrecovered and candidate status is unchanged.
branches.next_cursor: Build the Three-Spheres comparator from one shared primitive absolute 4D dataset and declared material/director gauge. Freeze R (or R=1), use separate response channels E_t=||t||/R, E_s=|log s|, and E_Q=||Q-I||_F, inject the same bounded mismatch used in Run 077, and report the response curves separately. Do not collapse them into one scalar. Keep exact-Hagalaz-source recovery as an independent provenance dependency; no reconstructed-operator promotion.
branches.exit_criterion: One paired case runs through both sides from a shared manifest with reproducible metadata and an auditable comparison report.
